ns2:section.sectionText: Section A: A TASTE OF FINANCE. An introductory course, intended for both current majors and non-majors, intended to give the flavor of Finance. Brief introductions to personal finance, investments and portfolio management, corporate finance, real estate, and insurance. Careers in the various financial fields will also be covered. Graded Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory. Not open to seniors.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
